# nautobot_manufacturer (Resource)

This object manages a manufacturer in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nautobot_manufacturer" "new" {
  description = "Created with Terraform"
  name        = "New Manufacturer"
}

output "resource_manufacturer" {
  value = nautobot_manufacturer.new
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Manufacturer's name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Manufacturer's description.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Manufacturer's creation date (RFC3339).
- `display` (String) Manufacturer's display name.
- `id` (String) Manufacturer's UUID.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the manufacturer.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the manufacturer.
- `url` (String) Manufacturer's URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# A manufacturer can be imported using its unique ID, e.g. '748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7'
terraform import nautobot_manufacturer "748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7"
```
